title: NASA's Terra Satellite Prepares to End Its Mission
paragraphs: Terra is a NASA satellite. It looks at Earth from space. It started its work in December 1999.
Terra has five tools. They watch fires, ice, dust and smoke. They also watch how people use the land.
Now Terra is old. It will stop its science work on December 1. The data will stay free for everyone.
